inputText: This is Tet — TET. Sound: T as in top. Shape hook: cereal bowl, open at the top, with its left rim curling in like a wave. Tip: Tet is OPEN at the top: a round bowl whose left side rises and curls inward, right side stands straight; do not mix it up with Samekh, Mem.
